critique: The render now clearly reads as cyan/blue bubble-like particles on black, with broad scale variation and an upward-oriented simulation that is much closer to the Rising Bubbles look. However, it is substantially overpopulated, especially by t4, making the image feel like a crowded drifting field rather than a composed stream of individual rising bubbles. The bubbles are also excessively soft and glow-like; their circular silhouettes merge into one another instead of retaining the cleaner, more legible bubble discs implied by the preset thumbnail.

suggestions.why: Reduce particle density so bubbles remain individually readable and the field does not become crowded at later frames.
Reduce excessive feathering so particles retain clearer circular bubble edges rather than blending into diffuse glowing blobs.
